text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. These tasks include understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where systems learn from data instead of following fixed rules. Deep learning, a more advanced subset, uses large neural networks to handle complex patterns, such as recognizing faces or translating speech. AI is already part of daily life: it powers virtual assistants, recommends movies, filters spam emails, and helps doctors analyze medical scans. As technology improves, AI continues to become smarter and more integrated into our routines.
